notes: Add Check Queue with customer names, check types, waiting positions, cancel, retry, skip, resume and a configurable 60-second timeout. Searches run one customer at a time; switching chats preserves each customer's work.

Check Member List first. Only a verified empty exact-member search becomes Username not found and advances the queue. Logout, missing pages, ambiguous member evidence and technical failures become Loading failed and pause the queue until an explicit retry or resume.

Recover minimal task metadata after refresh without automatically searching. Interrupted tasks require manual retry. Late responses cannot commit results after timeout; report-tab searches are serialized and deferred submissions can be cancelled. Backend reports and reply text are never persisted by queue recovery.
